entry.title: Perseid meteors favor darker Poconos ridgelines this week
entry.summary:
Astronomers expect the Perseid meteor shower to peak under relatively dark skies across northeastern Pennsylvania ridgelines.

Cloud cover and moonlight remain the largest uncertainties; observers should treat timing windows as approximate.

entry.title: Infrared canopy studies reveal summer heat stress patterns
entry.content: Researchers using infrared imaging mapped canopy temperature anomalies that may signal drought stress. Findings are early and do not prescribe land-management actions.
